name: Balance sheet by cost center
query:
SELECT
	gle.account AS account,
	SUM(CASE WHEN gle.cost_center = 'Clan - 188' THEN gle.debit - gle.credit ELSE 0 END) AS clan,
	SUM(CASE WHEN gle.cost_center = 'Colonie - 188' THEN gle.debit - gle.credit ELSE 0 END) AS colonie,
	SUM(CASE WHEN gle.cost_center = 'Groupe - 188' THEN gle.debit - gle.credit ELSE 0 END) AS groupe,
	SUM(CASE WHEN gle.cost_center = 'Louvette - 188' THEN gle.debit - gle.credit ELSE 0 END) AS louvette,
	SUM(CASE WHEN gle.cost_center = 'Meute - 188' THEN gle.debit - gle.credit ELSE 0 END) AS meute,
	SUM(CASE WHEN gle.cost_center = 'Troupe - 188' THEN gle.debit - gle.credit ELSE 0 END) AS troupe,
	SUM(CASE WHEN IFNULL(gle.cost_center, '') = '' OR gle.cost_center NOT IN ('Clan - 188', 'Colonie - 188', 'Groupe - 188', 'Louvette - 188', 'Meute - 188', 'Troupe - 188') THEN gle.debit - gle.credit ELSE 0 END) AS autres,
	SUM(gle.debit - gle.credit) AS total
FROM
	`tabGL Entry` gle
	INNER JOIN `tabAccount` acc ON acc.name = gle.account
WHERE
	gle.company = %(company)s
	AND gle.is_cancelled = 0
	AND gle.posting_date <= %(to_date)s
	AND acc.root_type IN ('Asset', 'Liability', 'Equity')
	AND acc.is_group = 0
GROUP BY
	gle.account
HAVING
	ABS(SUM(gle.debit - gle.credit)) > 0.005
ORDER BY
	acc.root_type,
	gle.account
